summary: Instrument landing system for runway 09/27 at EGGD out of service, with distance measuring equipment unavailable; pilots to expect a satellite-based approach.
text:
ILS RWY 09/27 U/S. DME NOT AVBL. PILOTS TO EXPECT GNSS APPROACH. 
WEATHER DEPENDANT. IN THE EVENT OF ADVERSE CONDITIONS RWY 27 CAT 3 
APPROACH AVAILABLE.
